name: borage-charming

purpose.why: Rebuilt on Evan's request (2026-10-22) to replace the Ranch tile's original model with a crafted one, keeping its game role.
purpose.audience: children building and playing in a miniature ranch

brief.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a borage plant clump with soft hairy leaves and star-shaped bright blue flowers, oversized plump petals and leaves, bouncy rounded toy-like shapes

concept.tool: Midjourney web app (midjourney.com/imagine), driven in Evan's signed-in Chrome by Claude through the Claude in Chrome extension, one job at a time, text prompts only (no image reference)

hero.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a borage plant clump with soft hairy leaves and star-shaped bright blue flowers, oversized plump petals and leaves, bouncy rounded toy-like shapes, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 1:1
hero.pick_reason: oversized star-shaped blue flowers over plump leaves, whole plant with margin

construction.by: modeler agent, directed by the art director (Claude)

rounds.change: first charming reshape: tiered rosette + dome leaves, 9 big stars on own stems
stars x1.3 with broader petals, longer rosette, more stem leaves, rounder footprint
steeper rosette with more droop, wider leaf body, stars x1.45
mound rebuilt as two tiers of arching paddle leaves (the stacked-plate look was gone)
wider bottom tier, bigger stem leaves, darker greens
no right-side skew, right flowers moved out, stars x1.5, depth to 0.30 m; 768 px final 0.733
flowers spread +-0.06 m in depth so the side and back read round (IoU cost 0.02, kept); final 768 px / 48 samples

what_was_done: Copied models/borage (build.py, make_views.py, hero_check.py, run.sh) and reshaped it. Same six objects and materials (Leaf_Green, Leaf_Pale, Stem_Green, Stem_Red, Petal_Blue, Flower_White), one material each, double-sided cards, flat colours, Z up, origin at the base on the ground, front -Y, height 0.41 m. No variants (plant).

Hero only (no turnaround for this asset). make_views.py keys the hero: the cast shadow is darkened cream (red above green) while every plant pixel has green above red, so the mask keeps only pixels that differ from the backdrop with G > R. hero_check.py is the normal model's front-on 15 deg camera, unchanged.

The normal clump's 10 flat rosette cards plus 50 small dome leaves became a chubby mound of 18 big pillowy paddle leaves in two tiers (10 low, 8 upper), each rising steeply from the crown and arching over so the outer half drapes toward the viewer. New plump_leaf: 12 triangles, midrib puffed up, round shoulders, blunt tip, edges curled down. A small faceted core keeps it solid.

15 small stars on red stalks became 9 OVERSIZED plump stars (about 1.9x the normal flower radius) on bouncy bowed stems, one stem each: broad shoulders and forward-cupped tips (20 triangles), a white eye cone, a short Stem_Red neck. Placed from the hero: top flower leaning left, a cluster spilling out to the right, small side-on and nodding ones, spread +-0.06 m in depth so the side view is round, not a flat card.
Seven small leaves up the stems and three round green buds on short spurs, as in the hero.

765 triangles (budget 1k; the normal is 993). 0.340 x 0.300 x 0.406 m (normal 0.368 x 0.327 x 0.410), width/depth 1.13 vs 1.125. to_game.py borage-charming installed simulations/regional-assets-charming/GF-249.glb and updated the charming manifest.
construction.creative_additions: Round green buds on spurs and a nodding star at the front left, for bounce.

geometry.up: Z (Blender source); Y in GLB and game
geometry.origin: centre of the footprint, on the ground

good: Hero IoU 0.714 at 768 px / 48 samples (0.733 before spreading the flowers in depth), against 0.657 for the normal model on its own hero.
Reads as the same borage (green mound, blue stars with white eyes) but toy-like: a round squat cushion of big soft leaves and a bouquet of chunky stars bouncing out of it.
Same footprint proportions, height, materials and roles as the normal one, so it swaps in place.
off: The hero's leaves are smooth and velvety with soft hairs; flat-shaded 12-triangle paddles read as facetted, slightly cabbage-like up close.
The hero's stems are thick and fuzzy and carry more leaves among the flowers; there is less green between the stars here (orange in the overlay at mid-left).
The hero's stars have a dark anther tip on the white centre; left out (too small to read in the tile).
The hero has no visible red stalks; Stem_Red is kept (short muted neck under each star) to keep the normal model's material set.

rights: Original work for Abbie's World. Concept art generated on Evan's Midjourney account; geometry generated procedurally, no third-party meshes or textures.
